content: A financial time series is a sequence of data points collected at regular intervals over a period of time, specifically related to financial markets or assets such as stocks, bonds, commodities, currencies, or indices. These data points generally include information such as opening and closing prices, highs and lows, trading volume, and other relevant metrics. By analyzing and studying financial time series data, investors and analysts can identify trends, patterns, and indicators that can help them make informed decisions about trading and investing in financial markets.
